Elections
The Elections Division is responsible for all parts of the administration of an election. Responsibilities include maintaining voter roles and registration, approving requests for mail-in and absentee ballots, and providing support and resources for electoral candidates. The Elections Division also works to secure polling places and voting equipment, and recruit and train poll workers for elections. Read more about
